stem: Drops of water fall randomly from a leaking tap at a constant average rate of 5.2 per minute.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the probability that at least 3 drops fall during a randomly chosen 30-second period.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Use a suitable approximating distribution to find the probability that at least 650 drops fall during a randomly chosen 2-hour period.
